note: The front face becomes a rhombus with vertices (+-1.5, +-1.5) and (-0.5, 0.5), (0.5, -0.5) (2D part [[2,1],[1,2]]). Probe 1 at (1.3, 1.3) is inside the rhombus but outside any square of side sqrt(5), which is what a TRS decomposition yields at any rotation; probe 2 at (0.7, -0.7) is outside the rhombus but inside any such square. About 29 px per unit at z = 0.
